feed.title: Frontend Myrmidon — TechMyrmidons
feed.subtitle: Reviewed catalogue changes. Entries appear when an editor signs content off, never before.

entry.title: AngularJS — published in the Frontend catalogue
entry.summary: Google’s first-generation framework — support officially ended January 2022, per its own site — distinct from Angular.

entry.title: Astro — published in the Frontend catalogue
entry.summary: Content-first framework that ships zero JavaScript by default.

entry.title: Bower — published in the Frontend catalogue
entry.summary: Front-end package manager whose own site now points users to other tools.

entry.title: CSS Modules — published in the Frontend catalogue
entry.summary: Build-time class-name scoping that keeps you writing ordinary CSS.

entry.title: Figma — published in the Frontend catalogue
entry.summary: Browser-based collaborative interface design tool.

entry.title: Grunt — published in the Frontend catalogue
entry.summary: Configuration-driven JavaScript task runner orchestrating plugins over files on disk.

entry.title: Gulp — published in the Frontend catalogue
entry.summary: Streaming task runner: tasks are JavaScript functions piping files through in-memory transforms.

entry.title: htmx — published in the Frontend catalogue
entry.summary: Hypermedia-driven interactivity via HTML attributes, with no client framework.

entry.title: Jest — published in the Frontend catalogue
entry.summary: Batteries-included JavaScript testing framework focused, in its own words, on simplicity.

entry.title: jQuery — published in the Frontend catalogue
entry.summary: DOM, event and AJAX library with a chainable API; much of what it provided is now native to the platform.

entry.title: Next.js — published in the Frontend catalogue
entry.summary: React framework for building full-stack web applications, in its own words — home of the App Router built on server components.

entry.title: npm — published in the Frontend catalogue
entry.summary: JavaScript package manager and registry, bundled with Node.js.

entry.title: Playwright — published in the Frontend catalogue
entry.summary: Cross-browser end-to-end testing with auto-waiting and strong debugging tools.

entry.title: pnpm — published in the Frontend catalogue
entry.summary: Content-addressed package manager that hard-links a global store instead of copying.

entry.title: Storybook — published in the Frontend catalogue
entry.summary: Develop and document components in isolation, outside the application.

entry.title: styled-components — published in the Frontend catalogue
entry.summary: Runtime CSS-in-JS: styles in tagged template literals, injected as scoped stylesheets at render time.

entry.title: TanStack Query — published in the Frontend catalogue
entry.summary: Async server-state library: caching, deduplication and background refetching for fetched data.

entry.title: Testing Library — published in the Frontend catalogue
entry.summary: Query components the way users find them, not by implementation detail.

entry.title: Vitest — published in the Frontend catalogue
entry.summary: Vite-native test runner with a Jest-compatible API.

entry.title: Bootstrap — published in the Frontend catalogue
entry.summary: Frontend toolkit shipping pre-built components on a responsive grid.

entry.title: React — published in the Frontend catalogue
entry.summary: Component-based UI library for building interfaces from composable pieces.

entry.title: Sass — published in the Frontend catalogue
entry.summary: CSS preprocessor adding variables, nesting and mixins, compiled to plain CSS.

entry.title: Tailwind CSS — published in the Frontend catalogue
entry.summary: Utility-first CSS framework: single-purpose classes composed directly in markup.

entry.title: Vite — published in the Frontend catalogue
entry.summary: Build tool serving source on demand over native ESM in development, bundling with Rolldown for production.

entry.title: webpack — published in the Frontend catalogue
entry.summary: Static module bundler building optimised bundles from a dependency graph.

entry.title: TypeScript — published in the Frontend catalogue
entry.summary: A typed superset of JavaScript that compiles to plain JavaScript, with types erased at build time.
